description: This file defines a class 'JsonParser' responsible for parsing JSON data according to specified shapes in the AWS SDK context. It handles different data types such as structure, list, map, timestamp, blob, and default values, converting JSON data into appropriate PHP data structures or objects.

classes.name: JsonParser
classes.description: A class implementing standard JSON parsing for AWS API responses, converting JSON data into PHP data types based on shape definitions.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON value according to the provided shape, converting it into appropriate PHP data structures or objects.

parameters.name: $shape
parameters.description: The shape/schema definition guiding how to parse the value.
